title: Contact
body:
**Center Stage Musicals** are performed at the **Mountain View Center for the Performing Arts' Main Stage**: 

**[500 Castro Street, CA 94041](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YyG9jma95yF1WGQC8)**

**[2510 Old Middlefield Way, CA 94043](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zjqeE39DjaKm8H9m7)**
